definitions.explanation: A type of graph that displays data points connected by straight line segments. Used to show changes over time or trends.

examples.japanese: {折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: To show temperature changes with a line graph.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{右肩上|みぎかたあ}がり→右肩上がり：15106_migikataagari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかる。
examples.english: Looking at this line graph, you can see that sales have been steadily increasing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{折|お}れ{線|せん}→折れ線：23011_oresen⟧ (broken line / polyline) + ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (graph). The name comes from the zigzag shape formed when data points are connected by straight lines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw a line graph
- {折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to represent with a line graph
- {折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}み{取|と}る→読み取る：04602_yomitoru⟧: to read/interpret a line graph

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{棒|ぼう}グラフ→棒グラフ：20688_bougurafu⟧: bar graph — uses rectangular bars to represent data
- ⟦{円|えん}グラフ→円グラフ：19567_engurafu⟧: pie chart — uses a circle divided into sectors
- ⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧: band graph / stacked bar chart

USAGE:
Line graphs are taught in Japanese elementary school math (⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧) and are one of the basic graph types students learn alongside bar graphs and pie charts.
